tooltip.forgottenrelics.false_justice: In inventory: incoming and outgoing ordinary damage becomes double true damage.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.deific_amulet: Necklace: clears effects, extinguishes fire, restores air and extends hurt immunity.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.paradox: A hit randomly splits 200 base damage between victim and wielder, subject to armor; repairs 1 durability each second.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.oblivion_amulet: Necklace: spends fire and entropy vis to defer damage. The debt may return at any time.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.arcanum: Necklace: 35% vis discount, passive recharge, 40% teleport dodge chance; may become dormant.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.dormant_arcanum: Necklace: consumes all six primals until the Nebulous Core awakens.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.fate_tome: Death protection in inventory: 100 vis of every primal; 30–90 second cooldown. Multiple copies risk disaster.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.dark_sun_ring: Ring: fire heals, attacks may reflect and extreme ordinary damage is negated; lesser hits may be amplified.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.chaos_core: In inventory: random damage scaling and redirection, with occasional random effects.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.mining_charm: Ring: +100% mining speed, +2 block reach. Identical charms do not stack.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.advanced_mining_: Ring: +300% mining speed, +4 block reach; stacks with the basic charm.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.telekinesis_tome: Hold use to grab; sneak to retain distance; attack to shock, sneak-attack to throw.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.ancient_aegis: Belt: 25% reduction, knockback resistance and healing; absorbs 40% of nearby other players’ damage.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.missile_tome: Hold use to fire homing missiles that pass through blocks.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.crimson_spell: Use to fire a slow homing orb; solid obstacles stop it.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.ghastly_skull: Experimental relic without a survival recipe; use sets your health to 1.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.obelisk_drainer: Hold use within 16 blocks of an Eldritch Obelisk to heal, feed and recharge wands.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.eldritch_spell: Use to launch armor-piercing dark matter; stronger in the Outer Lands.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.lunar_flares: Aim at a block within 128 blocks and hold use to call down lunar flares.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.teleportation_to: Use to teleport or swap with a target; sneak-use moves 16 blocks ahead. Disabled in the Outer Lands.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.shiny_stone: Necklace: staying still heals increasingly quickly; moving resets the buildup.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.superposition_ri: Ring: shares damage with other online wearers and may exchange locations across dimensions.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.soul_tome: Hold use to channel while stationary; drain nearby life and repel approaching enemies.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.dimensional_mirr: Sneak-use to mark your position; hold use for 4 seconds to return.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.weather_stone: Hold use for 3 seconds while raining; spends 25 air, earth and water vis to clear the weather.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.apotheosis: Hold use to summon 12 weapon variants; they launch after charging without breaking blocks.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.chaos_tome: Hold use to release chaotic orbs. They may attack you and cause destructive explosions.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.omega_core: Creative relic without a survival recipe: continual recharge and death prevention.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.xp_tome: Sneak-use toggles activity; use switches absorption/release. Transfers up to 5 XP points per tick.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.thunderpeal: Use to fire a gravity-affected orb that chains lightning to nearby creatures.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.terror_crown: Helmet: turns monsters against one another and weakens your gaze target; reveals nodes; repairs with gold or mana.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.overthrower: Aim at a creature and hold use for 7.5 seconds to banish it to the Nether. Cannot cast in the Nether.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.discord_ring: While worn, press the Discord key (default V) to use a Tome of Discord in your inventory.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.void_grimoire: Aim at a creature and hold use for 5 seconds to send it into the void; controlled by server config.
tooltip.forgottenrelics.oblivion_stone: Craft with a sample to bind, alone to reset; sneak-use toggles activity; use cycles three deletion modes.
